text:
megan_cs: Quick heads-up - I'm drafting a one-page customer-facing runbook for low-touch onboarding. Goal: reduce cold-starts and renewal risk by standardizing cache priming, batching, and streaming fallbacks. Need a short checklist + a tiny config example we can send to customers.
raj_eng: love it. can we include a tiny perf budget example (tokens/ms and cost targets)? helps CS call out when customers should move to Dedicated.
megan_cs: yes - add a 3-tier suggestion: starter (free), steady (pay-as-you-go), high-throughput (dedicated). include renewal signal flag (daily error spike > 5% over baseline).
lia_engineer: for caching, recommend 3 TTL tiers: ephemeral=30s, session=5m, profile=24h. also note prefill size: aim for <= 512 tokens to keep latency predictable.
sam_ops: +1. Also suggest a warmup job snippet customers can run pre-launch to populate prefix cache. small script works across SDKs.
kelsey_cs: can we add recommended monitoring hooks they should wire to Redwood Console? e.g., prefix_hit_rate, avg_latency_95, tokens_per_second. those help CS health checks.
megan_cs: good call. i'll add a one-line example for alert thresholds. also want a short questionnaire for enablement calls: expected qps, percent streaming users, critical paths, renewal timeline.
raj_eng: here's a tiny warmup script we use internally, feel free to paste:```bash
# run this once per instance before go-live
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt-medium","input":"prefill prompt","max_tokens":64}' > /dev/null
  sleep 0.5
done
```
lia_engineer: also include a graceful-degradation table: primary=streaming, fallback=non-streaming shorter context, last-resort=smaller quantized model. show expected latency delta e.g., +50-200ms for fallback.
megan_cs: i'll capture that. can we add a tiny FAQ entry for renewals: "When to recommend Dedicated?" answer: sustained p95 latency >200ms or predictable 1M+ tokens/day with cost sensitivity.
sam_ops: for field handoff, include a template Slack snippet the AE can send to engineering ops with account_id, predicted qps, go-live window, and enablement link. makes onboarding frictionless.
kelsey_cs: i'll draft the customer survey for feedback capture (3 quick NPS + 2 open prompts about priming pain). we'll auto-attach to the go-live checklist.
prefill-bot: reminder set - publish runbook draft to /docs/cs-playbooks/ by EOD tomorrow if there are no objections. :bell:
megan_cs: awesome team. i'll assemble and drop a final one-pager here by noon. if anyone wants to add a short example config (yaml/json) for TTLs/batching limits, paste it in this thread. :thumbsup:
